scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --filter ./backend restore && pnpm --filter ./government-registry restore

scripts.test: pnpm --filter ./web run test && pnpm --filter ./backend run test && pnpm --filter ./government-registry run test && pnpm --filter ./mobile run test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter ./web run test:coverage && pnpm --filter ./backend run test:coverage && pnpm --filter ./government-registry run test:coverage && pnpm --filter ./mobile run test:coverage
scripts.format: pnpm --filter ./backend run format && pnpm --filter ./government-registry run format && pnpm --filter ./web format && pnpm --filter ./mobile format
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter ./backend run lint && pnpm --filter ./government-registry run lint && pnpm --filter ./web lint && pnpm --filter ./mobile lint
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter ./backend run type-check && pnpm --filter ./government-registry run type-check && pnpm --filter ./web run type-check && pnpm --filter ./mobile run type-check
